manifest.purpose: Correct golden implementation: module quad_decoder(input wire clk, input wire rst, input wire a, input wire b, output reg signed [7:0] pos, output reg dir, output reg invalid) exactly matching pinned interface. Internally: reg [1:0] cur (holds {a,b} sampled each cycle), reg [1:0] prev (holds cur from prior cycle). Each posedge clk: if rst, pos<=0, dir<=0, invalid<=0, cur<=0, prev<=0 (synchronous, all regs reset together). Else: prev<=cur; cur<={a,b}; and based on comparing OLD cur (this cycle's cur, i.e. value before this edge, = S(N-1)) vs new sample {a,b}=S(N): if equal -> hold pos/dir, invalid<=0; if forward Gray step (00->01,01->11,11->10,10->00) -> pos<=pos+1 (signed wrap via 8-bit arithmetic), dir<=1, invalid<=0; if reverse step (00->10,10->11,11->01,01->00) -> pos<=pos-1, dir<=0, invalid<=0; if both bits differ (illegal) -> pos,dir hold, invalid<=1. Must use nonblocking assignments with correct evaluation order (compare against cur BEFORE updating cur) to get exactly 1-cycle latency per interface contract. dir must never update on hold/illegal cycles. invalid pulses exactly one cycle. No $stop/$finish/force/deposit/ifdef TESTBENCH constructs (SR3 compliance). Single self-contained module, synthesizable Verilog-2001, compiles under iverilog standalone.
